name: review
input: Proposal: replace the service's PostgreSQL-backed job queue (a jobs table polled with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, about 40 jobs a second at peak) with Redis Streams and consumer groups. Jobs would no longer commit in the same transaction as the business rows that enqueue them; a worker would acknowledge a job with XACK after it finishes. Redis would run as a single managed instance with AOF persistence every second. The change removes polling load from the database and should cut median enqueue-to-start latency from about 800 ms to under 50 ms.
